verdict.rationale: Mercury Books is a SaaS accounting platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question, but the evidence only describes one as upcoming: the launch post says an MCP layer "will let AI agents handle bookkeeping tasks" alongside an accounting API arriving "soon". No shipped MCP server, endpoint, or connection docs appear, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, so a roadmap promise does not count as delivery.
